<div class="justify lh-10"> - Merge sort: $n + n/2 + n/4 + \dots < 2n$, a geometric series. If the buffer is allocated only inside `merge`, after the recursive calls return, we get $S(n) = \max(S(n/2),\ Θ(n)) = Θ(n)$. - Naive Fibonacci: $T(n)$ is exponential, but $S(n)$ is only linear, because the calls `fib(n-1)` and `fib(n-2)` are sequential and only one chain is alive. </div>

Answers: (a) Θ(n), Θ(1); (b) Θ(n), Θ(n); (c) Θ(n), Θ(n); (d) Θ(n²), Θ(n²)
